function.mechanism: Starch is chemically treated (including bleaching routes in regulatory specifications) to alter functional properties used for texture and process performance; FDA controls this through reagent-specific limits in food starch-modified production.
common_food_categories: processed foods using modified starch ingredients
batter systems for commercially processed foods (for specific chlorine/calcium hypochlorite treatment route)
general food applications where food starch-modified is used under GMP

adi.basis: No E1403-specific EFSA ADI was identified in retrieved EFSA sources; the 2017 EFSA modified-starches opinion covered other E-numbers (E1404-E1451 subset) with ADI not specified for that assessed group.

efsa.key_finding: No dedicated EFSA re-evaluation for E1403 was located in retrieved EFSA sources; the closest EFSA opinion (2017) on other modified starches concluded no safety concern and used an ADI of not specified for that group.

adi.basis: WHO/JECFA database for Modified starches (including INS 1403 in synonyms) lists ADI as NOT SPECIFIED.

concerns.summary: E1403-specific recent toxicology and exposure studies were not robustly identified in required-source searches; direct evidence granularity is limited.
A retrieved modified-starch-related in vitro paper (PMID 23768322) examines cytotoxicity of nanoemulsions and is not an additive-specific E1403 dietary risk study.

no_concern_confirmed: JECFA lists ADI as NOT SPECIFIED for modified starches including INS 1403.
FDA permits use under 21 CFR 172.892 with explicit processing and limit conditions.
No IARC classification entry was found for bleached starch/E1403/INS 1403 in the IARC list dataset checked.

adi_exceedance.notes: No numeric ADI exists in the retrieved JECFA entry (ADI not specified), so standard numerical ADI exceedance framing is limited; E1403-specific intake data were not found.

risk_assessment.rationale: Current retrieved regulatory signals are low concern (FDA-approved use conditions; JECFA ADI not specified for the relevant modified-starch group; no IARC listing found), but E1403-specific modern toxicology and exposure data are limited.
key_factors: JECFA ADI: NOT SPECIFIED for modified starches including INS 1403
FDA authorization and conditions under 21 CFR 172.892
No dedicated EFSA E1403 opinion located in retrieved EFSA sources
No IARC listing found for E1403 terms in checked classification dataset
Sparse additive-specific recent PubMed safety evidence
